apps.name: Jadiv Print Center
apps.tagline: Self-healing printer manager + Silhouette Cameo plotter tab
apps.description: A PyQt6 print manager for Ubuntu/Kubuntu 24.04+ covering USB, network and remote CUPS server printers, with autodiscovery and a background watcher that repairs printers whose IP address or port changed -- the usual reason the stock Linux print stack works once and then quietly stops. Also includes a Plotter tab for Silhouette Cameo cutting plotters over USB: SVG/PNG/PDF import, a manual drawing tool with a shape catalog and text, roll-fed vinyl support, project save/load, cut/pen (including combined cut+draw jobs), and print-and-cut with a registration-mark preview that adapts to the artwork's own size.
apps.author: JapySoft TDY
